Writing uses the tiered crafting system: <!--- someone make this its own page --->
tier = complexity + item quality bonus + other bonuses.

Fractions will at least yield items in the lower quality, while having a chance at a higher tier.

1.35 yields a tier 1 item with a 35% chance for a tier 2 item. Tier 0 is considered a <b>failed craft</b> and does not yield any items.

Some of the writings also yield a few {{techpoint|blue}} techpoints.

''Only duration goes up''

Example desk II: notes + gold story + perks = -1.5 + 3 + 1.2 = 2.7, so 70% gold chance, and when it fails guaranteed silver.

== Prayers ==
Writing prayers is not influenced by any bonuses.
